name: Idle Crush Factory Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Idle Crush Factory on Steam now!

 

Idle Crush Factory is a physics-based incremental idle game where you crush shapes and build an automated factory that runs at the bottom of your screen while you browse or work. Earn cash, unlock upgrades, optimize your gears, and scale your factory in a satisfying progression loop. Wishlist now!
